title: Blue Hour and Inventory
author: Petra Oyelaran
blurb: Lena Yarrow, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
